question: Which employee grades are eligible for company-provided shared cab transport at Vanguard FinServ?
expected_answer: Company-provided shared cab transport is restricted exclusively to full-time employees in Grades G1 through G3. [Source: VFS-TP-2026-v1.0, Section 1.1]

question: Why are Grade G4 and above employees ineligible for roster cabs?
expected_answer: Employees in Grade G4 and above receive a fixed monthly transport allowance in their payroll and are therefore ineligible for company roster cabs. [Source: VFS-TP-2026-v1.0, Section 1.1]

question: Are contractors and interns eligible for Vanguard roster cabs?
expected_answer: No. Contractors and interns are not eligible for roster transport. [Source: VFS-TP-2026-v1.0, Section 1.1]

question: What is the distance radius from the Mumbai BKC office for shared cab pickups and drops?
expected_answer: Shared cab pickups and drops are provided only for residences located between 5 km and 25 km (road distance) from the Mumbai BKC office. [Source: VFS-TP-2026-v1.0, Section 1.2]

question: Which shifts qualify for Vanguard roster cabs?
expected_answer: Only employees working Rotational or Night Shifts (with shift start times before 07:00 AM or shift end times after 08:00 PM) qualify for roster cabs. Standard General Shift (09:30 AM - 06:30 PM) employees are not eligible. [Source: VFS-TP-2026-v1.0, Section 1.3]

question: When is a security escort mandatory for women employees at Vanguard FinServ?
expected_answer: A verified male security escort is mandatory for all women employees on office-to-home drops departing after 10:00 PM and on home-to-office pickups scheduled before 5:30 AM. [Source: VFS-TP-2026-v1.0, Section 2.1]

question: Where must the security guard sit, and how do women employees confirm safe arrival after a night drop?
expected_answer: During the 10:00 PM to 5:30 AM escort window, the security guard must sit in the front passenger seat beside the driver. Every woman employee must complete an automated IVR safe-reach confirmation call within 15 minutes of drop-off, or it triggers an immediate escalation to the BKC Security Control Room. [Source: VFS-TP-2026-v1.0, Section 2.2]

question: What is the booking cut-off time for roster cab requests?
expected_answer: All roster cab requests must be locked in at least 12 hours before the scheduled shift start time, or by 4:00 PM on the preceding working day, whichever is earlier. [Source: VFS-TP-2026-v1.0, Section 3.1]

question: How many hours in advance must I cancel an unused pickup to avoid a no-show?
expected_answer: Employees must cancel unused pickups at least 4 hours prior to the scheduled pickup time; cancellations inside the 4-hour window are treated as a No-Show. [Source: VFS-TP-2026-v1.0, Section 3.2]

question: What are the per-trip and monthly limits for ad-hoc cab reimbursements?
expected_answer: Ad-hoc cab reimbursements for emergency business travel or missed rosters due to verified client escalations are capped at INR 800 per trip, with a strict monthly limit of INR 4,000 per employee. [Source: VFS-TP-2026-v1.0, Section 4.1]

question: Who has the authority to approve an ad-hoc cab request?
expected_answer: Every ad-hoc cab request requires prior approval from the Business Unit Head (VP or above) via the internal Workplace Services portal or official email. Reporting Managers cannot approve ad-hoc cabs. [Source: VFS-TP-2026-v1.0, Section 4.2]

question: Who is eligible for airport cab bookings and what are the approval and cost rules?
expected_answer: Airport cab bookings are restricted solely to Grade G4+ employees or employees travelling for pre-approved client engagements. All airport transfers require VP approval and are capped at INR 3,000 per trip. [Source: VFS-TP-2026-v1.0, Section 4.3]

question: What is Vanguard FinServ's policy on Sunday, National Holiday, and Saturday cabs?
expected_answer: Company transport operations are strictly closed on Sundays and National Holidays, with no roster or ad-hoc cabs dispatched. Saturday pickups are permitted only for regulatory reporting or audit teams with written VP approval submitted by Friday 2:00 PM. [Source: VFS-TP-2026-v1.0, Section 5.1]

question: Can external guests or consultants ride in shared roster cabs, and who approves dedicated client cabs?
expected_answer: External guests, visitors, and consultants are strictly prohibited from boarding employee shared roster cabs. Dedicated vendor cabs for visiting clients may be arranged exclusively with prior approval from the Compliance Officer. [Source: VFS-TP-2026-v1.0, Section 6.1]

question: What are the penalties for 1st, 2nd, and 3rd no-shows at Vanguard FinServ?
expected_answer: Over a rolling 60-day period: the 1st no-show sends a formal alert to the employee and Reporting Manager; the 2nd no-show incurs a mandatory INR 500 payroll deduction; and the 3rd no-show results in a 30-day suspension of all company transport privileges. [Source: VFS-TP-2026-v1.0, Section 7.1]

question: Which department governs Vanguard FinServ's transport policy and what is the Transport Desk email?
expected_answer: The policy (VFS-TP-2026-v1.0) is governed by HR Operations, Vanguard FinServ India Ltd., and the Vanguard Transport Desk can be reached at bkc-transport@vanguardfinserv.example.com. [Source: VFS-TP-2026-v1.0, Abstract & Section 8.1]

question: I am a woman employee leaving BKC at 9:00 PM. Can I request a security escort even though it's before 10:00 PM?
expected_answer: Yes. Between 8:00 PM and 10:00 PM, women travel in GPS-tracked shared cabs without a mandatory escort, unless specifically requested 24 hours in advance. [Source: VFS-TP-2026-v1.0, Section 2.1]

question: What happens if I forget to answer the IVR confirmation call after reaching home at 11:30 PM?
expected_answer: If you do not complete the automated IVR safe-reach confirmation call within 15 minutes of drop-off, it triggers an immediate escalation to the BKC Security Control Room. [Source: VFS-TP-2026-v1.0, Section 2.2]

question: How long do I have to board the cab once it arrives at my gate before it counts as a no-show?
expected_answer: Failing to board within 5 minutes of cab arrival is recorded as a No-Show. [Source: VFS-TP-2026-v1.0, Section 7.1]

question: My Reporting Manager emailed approval for my emergency ad-hoc cab. Is that valid for reimbursement?
expected_answer: No. Reporting Managers cannot approve ad-hoc cabs; every ad-hoc cab request requires prior approval from the Business Unit Head (VP or above) via the Workplace Services portal or official email. [Source: VFS-TP-2026-v1.0, Section 4.2]

question: I am a Grade G2 analyst travelling to Delhi for a pre-approved client meeting. Can I book an airport cab?
expected_answer: Yes. While airport cabs are generally for Grade G4+, employees travelling for pre-approved client engagements are also eligible, subject to VP approval and a ceiling of INR 3,000 per trip. [Source: VFS-TP-2026-v1.0, Section 4.3]

question: I am on the regulatory audit team and need a cab this Saturday. When is the deadline to get VP approval?
expected_answer: For Saturday regulatory reporting or audit pickups, written VP approval must be submitted by Friday 2:00 PM. [Source: VFS-TP-2026-v1.0, Section 5.1]

question: When can an employee actually claim an ad-hoc cab reimbursement?
expected_answer: Ad-hoc cab reimbursements apply to emergency business travel or missed rosters due to verified client escalations, capped at INR 800 per trip and INR 4,000 per month with prior VP+ approval. [Source: VFS-TP-2026-v1.0, Section 4.1 & Section 4.2]

question: Can I book a cab on Independence Day if my VP approves it?
expected_answer: No. Company transport operations are strictly closed on Sundays and National Holidays, and no roster or ad-hoc cabs are dispatched on those days. [Source: VFS-TP-2026-v1.0, Section 5.1]

question: I live 4 km from the BKC office and work the night shift in Grade G1. Can I use the shared cab?
expected_answer: No. Shared cab pickups and drops are only provided for residences between 5 km and 25 km (road distance) from the Mumbai BKC office; residences closer than 5 km are not covered. [Source: VFS-TP-2026-v1.0, Section 1.2]

question: I live 27 km from BKC. Is there a nodal pickup point option in Vanguard's policy?
expected_answer: No. Residences farther than 25 km from the Mumbai BKC office are not covered by home-to-office shared cabs, and the policy does not specify a nodal pickup point option. Please contact bkc-transport@vanguardfinserv.example.com for clarification. [Source: VFS-TP-2026-v1.0, Section 1.2]

question: I am a Grade G3 employee working the 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM General Shift and living 12 km from BKC. Do I qualify for a roster cab?
expected_answer: No. Employees on the standard General Shift (09:30 AM - 06:30 PM) are not eligible for company cabs; only Rotational or Night Shifts (starting before 07:00 AM or ending after 08:00 PM) qualify. [Source: VFS-TP-2026-v1.0, Section 1.3]

question: My morning pickup is at 5:45 AM and I am a woman employee. Is a security escort mandatory?
expected_answer: No. A verified male security escort is mandatory only on drops after 10:00 PM and pickups scheduled before 5:30 AM. [Source: VFS-TP-2026-v1.0, Section 2.1]

question: My shift starts at 6:00 AM tomorrow. Can I book my roster cab at 5:30 PM today (12.5 hours before shift)?
expected_answer: No. Roster cab requests must be locked in at least 12 hours before shift start OR by 4:00 PM on the preceding working day, whichever is earlier—so 4:00 PM today was the deadline. [Source: VFS-TP-2026-v1.0, Section 3.1]

question: If I cancel my cab 3.5 hours before my pickup time, will it count as a no-show?
expected_answer: Yes. Unused pickups must be cancelled at least 4 hours prior to the scheduled pickup time; cancelling inside the 4-hour window is treated as a No-Show. [Source: VFS-TP-2026-v1.0, Section 3.2]

question: I had one no-show 45 days ago and another today. What is my penalty?
expected_answer: Because penalties are tracked over a rolling 60-day period, this counts as your 2nd no-show and incurs a mandatory INR 500 payroll deduction. [Source: VFS-TP-2026-v1.0, Section 7.1]

question: I am in the Marketing team and my VP approved a Saturday cab for a campaign launch. Can transport dispatch it?
expected_answer: No. Saturday pickups are permitted only for regulatory reporting or audit teams with written VP approval submitted by Friday 2:00 PM. [Source: VFS-TP-2026-v1.0, Section 5.1]

question: At AetherTech, women get a mandatory escort after 8:00 PM. Do I automatically get an escort for my 8:30 PM drop at Vanguard?
expected_answer: No. At Vanguard FinServ, a mandatory security escort applies after 10:00 PM (and before 5:30 AM). Between 8:00 PM and 10:00 PM, escorts are not mandatory unless requested 24 hours in advance. [Source: VFS-TP-2026-v1.0, Section 2.1]

question: Can I get a Director (Band L7+) to sponsor my intern for daily roster cabs?
expected_answer: No. Under Vanguard FinServ's policy, contractors and interns are not eligible for roster transport, with no sponsorship exception mentioned. [Source: VFS-TP-2026-v1.0, Section 1.1]

question: At NexaCore BioLabs, you can cancel up to 90 minutes before pickup. Can I cancel 2 hours before my Vanguard cab?
expected_answer: No. At Vanguard FinServ, unused pickups must be cancelled at least 4 hours prior to the scheduled pickup time; cancelling 2 hours before pickup counts as a No-Show. [Source: VFS-TP-2026-v1.0, Section 3.2]

expected_answer: No. Under Vanguard FinServ's policy, women employees must complete an automated IVR safe-reach confirmation call within 15 minutes of drop-off during the 10:00 PM - 5:30 AM window. [Source: VFS-TP-2026-v1.0, Section 2.2]

question: Can I claim reimbursement for taking a Rapido bike-taxi to the Mumbai BKC office?
expected_answer: Bike-taxi or two-wheeler reimbursement is not covered in Vanguard FinServ's transport policy. Please contact the Vanguard Transport Desk at bkc-transport@vanguardfinserv.example.com.

expected_answer: Airport lounge access is not covered in Vanguard FinServ's transport policy. Please contact the Vanguard Transport Desk at bkc-transport@vanguardfinserv.example.com.

expected_answer: The exact rupee amount of the Grade G4+ monthly transport allowance is not specified in Vanguard FinServ's transport policy. Please contact HR Operations or bkc-transport@vanguardfinserv.example.com.

expected_answer: Local train pass reimbursement is not covered in Vanguard FinServ's transport policy. Please contact the Vanguard Transport Desk at bkc-transport@vanguardfinserv.example.com.

expected_answer: Wheelchair-accessible vehicles or medical accommodation transport are not covered in Vanguard FinServ's transport policy. Please contact the Vanguard Transport Desk at bkc-transport@vanguardfinserv.example.com.
